title: Baseline: one parallel thinking round before each proof line, plan probe kept on in RL (fine-tune batch in four parts)
description: Starting incumbent for the test-time-thoughts loop: run 198's six untied blocks with n continuous thought positions after every `;` and `by` (inputs made from the model's own output at that token, one parallel pass per line), n drawn from 0-8 per training batch, a training-only plan probe at weight 0.3 in pretraining and RL fine-tuning, and the old harness's expert iteration moved into rl() with each round sampling every target 8 times at each of 0, 2, 4 and 8 thoughts. Sets the first 3-seed mean under the shared harness. Same recipe as 700, which ran out of GPU memory in the first RL fine-tune; each fine-tune step's 128 records are now sorted by length and run 32 at a time with gradients accumulated.
hypothesis: Thinking before every line, with the thoughts supervised by a plan probe during RL as well as pretraining, keeps the model using its thoughts after RL; in the 2026-10-06 spike one block of thoughts up front, unsupervised in RL, was ignored after four rounds.
expected_delta: establishes the incumbent; expect roughly 450-600 at 8 thoughts and, since 700's pretrained models went from 3.6% valid samples at 0 thoughts to 12.0% at 8, a positive gap over 0 thoughts unless RL erases it

arch.type: gpt, 6 untied Peri-LN blocks, plus n continuous thought positions after every `;` and `by` (LayerNorm(output at the trigger) + slot embedding, one parallel pass per line)
arch.pos: alibi on 4 heads, none on 4; thoughts share their trigger's position

optimizer.name: muon (polar express) on block matrices and head + adamw on the rest

config.init: orthogonal on block matrices, fork default elsewhere

thoughts.probe: token after the next `:=` or `exact`, read off the last thought, weight 0.3, pretraining and RL

rl.rounds: until another round would not fit in RL_SECS
rl.ft_optimizer: adamw, warmup 50 then cosine to lr/10
rl.loss: next-token CE plus the plan probe at weight 0.3

rl.oracle: Lean AND nd_verify accepted samples of the model's own attempts

eval.metric: dev-transfer theorems solved at L_true >= 7 with KNOB at EVAL_LEVEL
